scenes.text: You think trees are just peaceful giants soaking up the sun, but underneath your feet, a silent, brutal war is raging right now and you have been completely lied to about nature.
These towering plants actually use a massive underground fungal network to sabotage and even murder their closest rivals by pumping toxic, lethal chemicals directly through the soil.
Even crazier, they hire mercenary fungi to steal valuable nutrients from dying trees and funnel them directly to their own offspring in a ruthless, hidden forest empire.
Your local park or backyard is basically a medieval battlefield, so let me know in the comments if you knew trees were this savage and hit that follow button for more mind-blowing facts!
